title: ArgOS conditions snapshot
description: One snapshot per tick (1 Hz in ship time): what the state estimator hands the core. Every field carries value, source, age_s, confidence and stale. Signal names, types, stale limits and fallbacks are in config/signals.yaml; the contract is docs/STATE_ESTIMATION.md. The snapshot holds no wall-clock time, so a replay reproduces it exactly; wall-clock timing goes to the timing log.
